page_title: CAN 0-3 MOR | Canada v Morocco 04/07/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.
90+8' 0 - 3 Goal! Brahim Diaz provides Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
90+7' Alistair Johnston (Canada) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
90+6' Jayden Nelson (Canada) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
90+5' Jacob Shaffelburg (Canada) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+5' Canada quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+5' Jacob Shaffelburg (Canada) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Canada force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+4' Maxime Crepeau (Canada) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' Canada take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' Jonathan Osorio (Canada) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Niko Sigur leaves the pitch and Jonathan Osorio (Canada) comes on.
87' Tajon Buchanan comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jayden Nelson (Canada).
87' Mohamed Ouahbi has decided to substitute Azzedine Ounahi and he is replaced by Samir El Mourabet (Morocco).
87' Substitution. Marwane Saadane (Morocco) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Issa Diop walks off.
87' Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) commits a rough foul. Michael Oliver stops the game and makes a call.
86' Canada take a short corner kick.
85' Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!
84' Jonathan David (Canada) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
82' 0 - 2 Goal! Brahim Diaz plays a simple square pass into the feet of Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the top right corner. 0:2.
81' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
80' The foul by Promise David (Canada) was seen by Michael Oliver who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
80' The resulting corner from Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

79' Tajon Buchanan (Canada) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Bono! The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Canada.
78' Substitution. Jacob Shaffelburg (Canada) in, Richie Laryea out.
78' Jesse Marsch has decided to make a change. Promise David (Canada) replaces Ali Ahmed.
78' Jonathan David (Canada) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot high over the bar.
76' Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Canada have a free kick from a promising distance.
69' The attendance for today's match is 68777.
68' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
67' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Cyle Larin (Canada) for a tough tackle.
66' The linesman raises his flag. Richie Laryea (Canada) is adjudged offside.
65' Ali Ahmed (Canada) brings an opponent down and Michael Oliver interrupts the game.
64' Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
63' Substitution. Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi will be replaced by Cyle Larin (Canada).
63' Mohamed Ouahbi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Chemsdine Talbi (Morocco) replacing Bilal El Khannouss.
63' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ayyoub Bouaddi as he is replaced by Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco).
62' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Canada) is penalised for a foul. Michael Oliver had a clear view and blows his whistle.
60' Tajon Buchanan (Canada) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
59' The resulting corner from Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) comes to nothing.
58' Ali Ahmed (Canada) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Canada have been awarded a corner kick.
58' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) commits a foul and Michael Oliver immediately signals a free kick.
56' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
55' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Morocco.
55' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Canada) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
53' Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco) is adjudged offside.
50' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Achraf Hakimi provided an assist for the goal.
50' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
49' Luc De Fougerolles (Canada) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Michael Oliver didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
48' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) works the corner short.
48' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Canada) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Canada will take a corner kick.
47' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' Michael Oliver blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' Michael Oliver shows the yellow card to Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) for a heavy challenge.
43' Jonathan David (Canada) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
41' Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
40' Richie Laryea (Canada) picks up a yellow card.
40' The referee gives a yellow card to Achraf Hakimi (Morocco).
37' Moise Bombito (Canada) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Oliver no option but to blow his whistle.
35' A dangerous looking corner kick from Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) is cleared to safety by the defence.
34' A cross from Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
32' Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco) is caught offside!
30' Luc De Fougerolles (Canada) commits a foul during an attacking move.
29' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco), whose effort would probably have ended inside the left post.
28' Alistair Johnston (Canada) makes a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
24' A cooling break is underway.
24' Jonathan David (Canada) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
23' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Bono.
22' Mohamed Ouahbi is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Ismael Saibari (Morocco) suffers an injury and Soufiane Rahimi comes on.
20' A yellow card for a tackle by Redouane Halhal (Morocco). Michael Oliver doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
19' Alistair Johnston (Canada) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
18' Canada have been awarded a corner kick.
18' Tajon Buchanan (Canada) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
17' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
16' Richie Laryea (Canada) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
15' Michael Oliver blows for a foul after Richie Laryea (Canada) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
13' An attempted cross from Alistair Johnston (Canada) is cleared.
12' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
10' What a sweet touch by Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Canada) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Bono to hold.
10' Tajon Buchanan (Canada) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and it's Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Canada) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Canada.
6' The resulting corner from Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) is cleared.
6' Jonathan David (Canada) cracked a first-time shot, but the goalkeeper pulled off an amazing save. The ball goes out of play. Canada are awarded a corner kick.
6' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) launches a cross from the corner, but Bono is alert to thwart the effort.
5' Richie Laryea (Canada) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Canada force a corner. They send men into the box.
